text:
sam: Ran onboarding stress test on sampleapp and hit a cascade: prefetch + pagination caused queued pages and a flurry of 429s, memory climbed. Repro: new org, ~20 concurrent users, prefetch on. :grimacing:

amy: which sampleapp (lang)? logs?

sam: JS (nextjs). logs: repeated WARN page-fetch status=429, many inflight requests. config used:
```
page_size: 40
prefetch: 6
client_window: 20
max_concurrency: 10
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 3
  base_backoff_ms: 150
```

kelvin: parity note: go/py clients have token-bucket smoothing; JS uses a semaphore. JS doesn't reduce inflight when 429s happen.

amy: two fixes: short-term clamp prefetch based on client_window + circuit when 429s high; long-term align JS semantics to smoothing.

sam: prototyped clamp: `const clamp = Math.max(1, Math.floor(config.client_window / 5)); prefetch = Math.min(config.prefetch, clamp);` Reduced 429 spikes and memory stabilized.

kelvin: add exponential backoff with jitter and have retry handler signal prefetch controller to reduce targets (e.g., halve for 30s). Also a circuit that pauses prefetch when 429 rate >15% over 20s.

amy: yes. add `DEBUG_PREFETCH=true` flag and header `X-RW-Prefetch-Debug: true` to emit inflight counts for support.

ci-bot: integration CI: flaky test in devex/sampleapp prefetch_flow. https://ci/reports/4982

amy: sam, add deterministic e2e that fakes 429 responses so CI can validate without timing flakiness.

sam: opening draft PR with clamp, circuit, debug header, and synthetic e2e: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/510 (WIP). ETA: EOD.

kelvin: filing SDK parity issue: prefer token-bucket smoothing in JS or at least document difference. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1033

amy: short-term docs note: recommend `prefetch: 1` for small orgs during onboarding until stable. Add devex docs entry about clamping and circuit rules.

sam: will add telemetry metric `prefetch_pauses` and update changelog to mark experimental. Will ping when PR ready.

amy: thanks team. :thumbsup:
